:::{#exr-held-out-unbiased}
#### A held-out set estimates the generalization error

A prediction rule $\fitted$ is fitted to a training set $\mathcal{T}$.
A held-out set of $m$ observations
$(x_{0,1}, y_{0,1}), \ldots, (x_{0,m}, y_{0,m})$
is drawn from the same population as the new observation $(X_0, Y_0)$
of @def-generalization-error,
each independently of $\mathcal{T}$.
Write $\prederr_{0,j} \eqdef \fitted(x_{0,j}) - y_{0,j}$
for the [prediction error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-error)
on held-out observation $j$.

Show that, given $\mathcal{T}$,
the expected [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of the held-out predictions is $\generr_{\mathcal{T}}$.

:::
